scenario: 今天 AI 搜索这条线有两个主题。一个是检索和重排怎么更贴近真实需求。微信搜索的 WeSearch 不再让多主题文档挤进一条 Semantic ID 路径，已经接管全部流量。Re³Rank 先让一个模型写出推理，再按推理里的词对各候选的注意力排序，DMReranker 把 query 里附加的要求拆成小题逐条判断。另一个是 agent 式的搜索。DR Pixel 直接对着论文页面图片检索和推理，Mind2Report 写商业分析报告，还有一篇训练模型在问题缺信息时先追问。

papers.title: WeSearch: A Unified Model-Centric Retrieval Framework for WeChat Search
papers.authors: Kepu Zhang, Yuzhe Cai, Yue Shu, Dawei Chen, Jinhai Zhu, Yuan Xu, Zehua Dai, Tongke Ni, Ziyao Chen, Chen Fu, Jie Shao, Chao Wang, Xiangmin Wang, Ruifeng Zhao, Rongchun Yao, Jie Yin, Weixin Qiu, Nan Song, Junyang Li, Fan Li, Quanchao Hui, Yulong Ou, Qiang Chen, Hao Cao, Sen Yang
papers.abstract: We present WeSearch, a unified, model-centric retrieval framework for large-scale, continuously evolving content search. Prevailing methods assign documents fixed hierarchical Semantic IDs, implicitly assuming each document follows a single coherent semantic path-an assumption that often breaks down for multi-topic documents. WeSearch instead retrieves query-relevant clusters and then ranks atomic documents within the resulting query-specific candidate space, decoupling candidate pruning from fine-grained relevance modeling. Combined with relevance-aware training, compact document representations, and incremental index updates, this design enables weekly-or daily when needed-model refreshes. Deployed as the primary semantic retrieval path in WeChat Search alongside a lexical syntax tree, WeSearch shows consistent one-week A/B gains on corpora from hundreds of millions to billions of documents, and a one-month full-traffic A/B test confirms stable improvements of +0.68% CTR and +2.27% per-user article clicks, together with a 41% reduction in retrieval resource cost and a 19 ms reduction in graphic-text retrieval latency. WeSearch is now fully deployed in WeChat Search, serving 100% of production traffic.
papers.summary: 微信搜索的 WeSearch 用一个模型替掉了原来并行的多路召回：先按 query 找出相关的文档簇，再在这些簇里逐篇给文档打相关分，把粗筛和精细判断分开。它不像生成式检索那样给每篇文档一个固定的层级 Semantic ID，那种做法默认一篇文档只走一条语义路径，可一篇文章常常同时讲好几件事。索引可以增量更新，模型从原来的每月更新变成每周、必要时每天刷新。它已作为微信搜索的主召回上线，一个月全量 A/B 里 CTR 提升 0.68%，检索资源成本降了 41%。==多取一些簇来保召回，谁更相关交给逐篇打分==。

papers.title: Re$^3$Rank: Listwise Reranking with Reasoning-Conditioned Retrieval Heads
papers.authors: Ruiyi Yan, Zhuoyuan Mao, Yugo Murawaki, Yiwen Guo
papers.abstract: Attention-based rerankers score each candidate by the attention mass that retrieval heads route to it from the question, but the question, serving as a fixed query, carries limited information for locating relevant evidence. We propose Re$^3$Rank, a listwise reranker built on reasoning-conditioned retrieval heads (RRHeads). A generator first writes a reasoning trace over the question and the candidates, and a scorer then uses the trace tokens as the attention query of a few selected RRHeads, reading relevance as continuous scores. We present a straight-through estimator to propagate the ranking loss through the discrete trace, so that the generator and the scorer can be trained jointly for ranking. Averaged over 9 benchmarks, Re$^3$Rank outperforms 11 baseline rerankers: our 4B variant exceeds the strongest baseline by 3.11 NDCG@10 points on average, and even our 0.6B variant surpasses rerankers with up to 32B parameters.
papers.summary: Re3Rank 改的是注意力重排里拿什么去看候选：先让一个模型读完问题和候选，写一段推理过程，再让另一个模型拿推理里的 token 去看，按每个候选分到的注意力排序。已有做法让问题本身的 token 去看，可问题常缺找证据要用的关键信息。9 个问答数据集上，4B 版本的 R@3 平均 76.70，比同为 4B 的 QRRanker 高 3.31 个点。==决定排序的，是拿什么去看候选==。

papers.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Tiansheng Hu, Yichuan Wang, James V. Talwar, Nicholas Tomlin, Chen Zhao, Sewon Min
papers.abstract: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.
papers.summary: 让模型查论文时直接看页面截图，而不是先把 PDF 转成文字再搜，问答准确率会更高，检索次数还更少。DR Pixel 把约 106 万张论文页面渲染成图，每张图编码成一个向量。智能体用文字发起搜索，拿回最相关的几张页面图，并在整个推理过程中一直看着这些原图，表格和曲线不会因为转文字而走样。不做任何训练，只是换成看页面，闭源和开源的三个模型都比转成文字再另加一个搜图工具的方式准确率高 5 个点以上，检索调用少 20% 到 30%。

deep_reading.title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models

papers.title: Every Clause Counts: Instruction-Following Reranking by Multiplying Small, Answerable Questions
papers.authors: S. M. Mahbub Uddin Ahmed, Abdullah Al Musaddiq
papers.abstract: People often attach instructions to their search queries, asking for pages written for beginners, documents in a certain language or official sources only. Most rerankers were trained to judge topical relevance and treat such instructions as a few extra words. On the InfoSearch benchmark, even GPT-4o used as a list-wise reranker reaches an average WISE (Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation) of only 33.5. We present DMReranker (Decision-Model Reranker), a zero-shot reranker that splits an instructed query into a topic and a short list of typed clauses. A small judge model answers one narrow question per clause, and the answer probabilities are multiplied into a single score. Nothing is trained, and the configuration was frozen before the test runs. Reranking the same top-100 candidates as the published baselines, DMReranker reaches a macro WISE of 50.9 over all six InfoSearch dimensions while keeping original-mode nDCG@10 at 82.9. It trails GPT-4o on the stricter SICR (Strict Instruction Compliance Ratio) metric, 19.2 against 32.1. We show that this gap follows from how a product of probabilities behaves when SICR compares raw scores across runs. Computed from ranks, our SICR is 67.0. On the same judge, splitting the instruction raises WISE from 32.9 to 47.6 over a single combined question, while raw-score SICR falls. Scoring all six dimensions cost about $10 at list price.
papers.summary: 搜索重排可以不训练任何参数，就照顾到用户写在 query 后面的要求，比如要写给新手的、要某种语言的、只要官方来源。DMReranker 把带要求的 query 拆成主题和几条具体条件，让一个小模型对每条条件只回答一个窄问题，再把各题判定满足的概率乘起来当总分。WISE 分看的是：加上要求时符合条件的文档有没有往前挪，换成相反要求时有没有往后挪。用 GPT-4o 做重排，WISE 平均只有 33.5，DMReranker 达到 50.9。==哪一条要求明显不满足，总分就会被压得很低==。

papers.title: MCTS-KBQA: Monte Carlo Tree Search with Information Gain Rewards for Knowledge Base Question Answering
papers.authors: G.J. Xiong, Haochen Li, Zonghong Dai, Liqiang Wen, Wen Ping Zhao
papers.abstract: This work investigates how to improve large language model (LLM)-based reasoning for knowledge base question answering (KBQA) via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). Applying MCTS to LLM-based KBQA remains challenging because reward design is difficult and rollout-based search is computationally expensive. Existing MCTS-style methods either rely on direct LLM scoring or require substantial data to train separate reward models, and they often provide rewards only at terminal states. To address these limitations, we propose Fast MCTS, which replaces terminal rollouts with an information gain (IG) reward for intermediate states. The IG reward is implemented as a question-conditioned PPL-ratio proxy over sanitized interaction histories, computed by forward passes of an open-source instruction LLM without additional reward-model training. Experiments on four KBQA benchmarks show that Fast MCTS consistently outperforms linear baselines and generally improves the accuracy-cost trade-off relative to rollout-based Classic MCTS. Code and data are available at https://github.com/JimXiongGM/MCTS-KBQA.

papers.summary: 用 MCTS 帮大模型在知识库上一步步查答案时，中间步骤可以不训练奖励模型、也不模拟到底，就打出有用的分。办法是把截至这一步的查询记录交给一个开源指令模型，分别算带上原问题和不带原问题时这段记录的困惑度。带上问题后困惑度降得越多，说明查到的东西和问题越相关，这一步的奖励就越高。以往要么每一步都模拟到底、再给最终状态打分，代价很高；要么另训一个奖励模型，需要大量数据。新办法每个新节点只要两次前向计算。在 4 个 KBQA 基准上，它稳定好于只走一条路径、不做搜索的方法；和模拟到底的经典树搜索比，准确率和成本的权衡一般更好。

papers.title: Don't Guess, Ask Wisely: Benchmarking and Training Proactive Elicitation in Open-Domain LLM Conversations
papers.authors: Rongyu Zhang, Mutian Bao, Jinjian Zhang, Yuetian Du, He Xu, Wei Zhou, Xiaojun Zhu, Ming Kong, Jie Liu, Linjian Mo, Qiang Zhu
papers.abstract: When user queries are incomplete, large language models should ask targeted questions before committing to an answer, a capability we call proactive elicitation, yet evaluation on real user-assistant queries across seven LLMs (8B to frontier) shows that fewer than 11% of underspecified queries trigger a follow-up question. To benchmark and train this capability, we introduce VagueBench, where each seed query is annotated with structured intent and detail units then degraded into intent-vague and fully-vague variants via controlled removal of linguistic cues, yielding known hidden information sets for evaluating both when and what to ask. We propose DialogGRPO, an offline reinforcement learning method that organizes multi-turn elicitation as a dialogue-state directed acyclic graph, where candidate questions at each node receive dense turn-level rewards combining immediate information gain with lookahead value through group-relative comparison, enabling fine-grained credit assignment without runtime simulation. DialogGRPO elicits missing information on over 88% of vague queries with substantial gains in both recovery efficiency and answer coverage, without over-asking on complete queries, outperforms prompting and test-time-scaling baselines, and generalizes zero-shot to MultiWOZ 2.4 and AmbigQA.
papers.summary: 用户的问题常常缺关键信息，大模型却很少反问。作者在真实用户提问上测了多个模型，缺信息的问题里只有不到 11% 会换来一个追问。作者从完整问题里删掉细节造出模糊版本，删了什么事先已知。训练方法 DialogGRPO 先用外部大模型离线把对话展开成一张图，节点是已经问出了哪些信息，边是候选追问。每个追问的分数是两部分之和。一部分是这一问新问出几条信息，另一部分是从问完后的状态出发，在图上随机走几条后续对话。每条对话的得分是最后问出的信息有多全，再按用了几轮扣分，几条取平均。训练后，模型在 88% 以上的模糊问题上问出了缺失信息，对完整的问题也不乱问。

papers.title: Learning to Adjudicate: Verifier-Guided Multi-Agent Reasoning for E-Commerce Relevance
papers.authors: Shi Shu, Hao Chen, Baopu Qiu, Chao Wei, Weiru Zhang, Xiu Li, Xiaoyi Zeng
papers.abstract: Relevance modeling is fundamental to e-commerce search, determining how well retrieved products satisfy the needs expressed in a user's query. Accurate judgments require interpreting user intent, comparing product attributes, and applying business-specific matching criteria. Current methods based on large language models (LLMs) leverage contextual understanding and reasoning, focusing on incorporating domain-specific context and enhancing reasoning performance. Despite these advances, difficult query-product pairs remain challenging when evidence from different perspectives supports conflicting conclusions. A single reasoning pass may fail to reconcile these conflicts and ensure that decisive evidence guides the final judgment. To address this challenge, we propose Collaborative Adjudication with Debate and Replay Experience (CADRE), a framework for evidence-based adjudication in e-commerce relevance assessment. CADRE organizes three expert agents sharing a frozen backbone to analyze product attributes, user intent, and business rules in separate contexts, while a trainable Verifier assesses their supporting evidence against the applicable matching criteria to determine relevance. Under expert disagreement, a Verifier-guided debate elicits targeted clarification and revision of disputed interpretations before final adjudication. We optimize the Verifier through multi-turn group relative policy optimization and adapt successful-experience replay so that trajectories yielding correct terminal labels can be reused alongside fresh rollouts in subsequent updates. For efficient online serving, we use CADRE as an offline teacher to distill its relevance judgments into a lightweight student model. Offline evaluations and online A/B tests on an e-commerce search advertising platform demonstrate that CADRE improves relevance classification and key business and relevance satisfaction metrics.
papers.summary: 电商搜索判断商品和 query 相不相关，难在几方面证据会互相打架：属性看着对，用户意图却不对，业务规则又另有要求。一次推理很难把这些冲突理清。CADRE 让三个专家分别看商品属性、用户意图和业务规则，它们共用同一个冻结的大模型，再由一个可训练的裁判模型检查各自的证据。专家意见不一致时，裁判针对分歧追问，让专家澄清或修改后再下结论。这套流程太重，线上用不起，作者把它当老师，蒸馏成一个轻量模型上线。在搜索广告平台各占 10% 流量的 7 天 A/B 测试里，业务指标和相关性满意度都有提升。

papers.title: Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization
papers.authors: Anindya Nag, Ambuj Mehrish, Sebastiano Vascon
papers.abstract: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.
papers.summary: 多模态检索里，一条视频可能缺音频、字幕又有噪声，只靠这条样本自己的几种模态很难学好表示。论文在训练时把每条样本的每种模态当成一个节点，用超图的边把同一样本的几种模态、以及语义相近样本的模态连在一起，一条边可以同时连好几个节点。特征沿这些边互相传递，一条样本的表示就掺进了相似样本的信息。训练的检索损失算在这些掺了邻居信息的表示上，梯度传回编码器，这些信息就学进了编码器。检索时只用编码器直接给出的表示，超图丢掉不用，开销不变。在 17 组视频设置上，它在两个检索方向都好于现有的多模态对齐方法 GRAM，文本搜视频的平均 R@1 从 63.4 提到 68.2。即使九成片段缺一种模态，提升依然存在。

papers.title: Mind2Report: Expert-Level Commercial Report Synthesis via Cognitive Deep Research Agent
papers.authors: Mingyue Cheng, Daoyu Wang, Qi Liu, Shuo Yu, Xiaoyu Tao
papers.abstract: Synthesizing informative commercial reports from massive and noisy web sources is critical for high-stakes business decisions. Although recent deep research agents (DRAs) achieve notable progress, their reports remain limited in quality, reliability, and coverage. These mainly stem from ambiguous intents that cause search drift, retrieved web content that rapidly saturates the context window, and single-pass synthesis that limits report comprehensiveness. In this work, we propose Mind2Report, a cognitive deep research agent that emulates commercial analysts to synthesize expert-level reports. Mind2Report first probes fine-grained commercial intent to establish a structured outline, then recursively explores web sources and distills validated evidence into research memory to preserve context efficiency. Meanwhile, the research memory and outline continuously co-evolve, refining the report structure to avoid rigid initial planning. Finally, Mind2Report iteratively synthesizes the report based on the evolving outline and accumulated evidence. Together, these designs enable reliable and context-efficient long-horizon commercial deep research. To rigorously evaluate commercial DRAs, we further construct QRC-Eval, comprising 200 real-world commercial tasks and a holistic evaluation framework covering report quality, reliability, and coverage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Mind2Report consistently outperforms leading proprietary and open-source DRAs, while ablations verify the effectiveness of each module and further analyze the challenges they address. We expect this work to advance the development of commercial deep research agents.

papers.summary: 让做深度研究的 agent 写商业分析报告，常见三个毛病。意图没问清，搜着搜着就跑题。网页内容很快塞满上下文。报告一次写完，覆盖不全。Mind2Report 照着分析师的做法来，先把用户真正想要的拆细，列出提纲。然后逐层搜网页，把核实过的证据摘进一份研究笔记，而不是把原网页塞进上下文。提纲随着笔记不断调整，最后按提纲分多轮写成报告。作者还建了一个包含 200 个真实商业任务的评测集，从质量、可靠性和覆盖面打分，Mind2Report 在上面优于主流的闭源和开源同类 agent。

papers.title: Learning to Erase Private Knowledge from Multi-Documents for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yujing Wang, Jinwen Chen, Hainan Zhang, Liang Pang, Yongxin Tong
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a promising technique for applying LLMs to proprietary domains. However, retrieved documents may contain sensitive knowledge, posing risks of privacy leakage in generative results. Thus, effectively erasing private information from retrieved documents is a key challenge for RAG. Unlike traditional text anonymization, RAG should consider: (1) the inherent multi-document reasoning may face de-anonymization attacks; (2) private knowledge varies by scenarios, so users should be allowed to customize which information to erase; (3) preserving sufficient publicly available knowledge for generation tasks. This paper introduces the privacy erasure task for RAG and proposes Eraser4RAG, a private knowledge eraser which effectively removes user-defined private knowledge from documents while preserving sufficient public knowledge for generation. Specifically, we first construct a global knowledge graph to identify potential knowledge across documents, aiming to defend against de-anonymization attacks. Then we randomly split it into private and public sub-graphs, and fine-tune Flan-T5 to rewrite the retrieved documents excluding private triples. Finally, PPO algorithm optimizes the rewriting model to minimize private triples and maximize public triples retention. Experiments on four QA datasets demonstrate that Eraser4RAG achieves superior erase performance than GPT-4o.

papers.summary: RAG 检索回来的文档可能带着隐私，只在单篇文档里抹掉名字还不够，几篇文档拼起来，被删掉的信息仍可能被推出来。这篇论文先把检索到的多篇文档抽成一张统一的知识图谱，把哪些事实算隐私交给使用者指定，再训练 Flan-T5 改写文档，删掉隐私事实、保留公开事实。之后用 PPO 继续优化，改写后留下的隐私越少、保住的公开知识越多，奖励就越高。在 4 个问答数据集上，它抹除隐私的效果好于直接让 GPT-4o 改写。
